    "Random\nBaseline"
]

accuracies = [84.3, 79.1, 75.6, 72.4, 68.9, 50.0]

drops_from_full = [84.3 - a for a in accuracies]

colors = ['#2ecc71',  # Full model - green
          '#3498db',  # w/o Data Augmentation - blue
          '#2980b9',  # w/o Pre-training - darker blue
          '#1abc9c',  # w/o Attention Module - teal
          '#16a085',  # w/o Augmentation & Pre-training - darker teal
          '#bdc3c7']  # Random baseline - light gray

# Create single figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot: Bar chart with accuracy values and drop annotations
bars = ax.bar(range(len(models)), accuracies, color=colors)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Ablation Study Results', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(models)))
ax.set_xticklabels(models, rotation=0, ha='center', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylim(45, 85)
ax.set_yticks(range(45, 90, 10))

             f'{acc:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Ablation Study Visualization Script
Shows the contribution of each component to model performance.
"""

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Ablation study data
models = [
    "Full Model",
    "w/o Data\nAugmentation",
    "w/o Pre-\ntraining",
    "w/o Attention\nModule",
    "w/o Augmentation\n& Pre-training",
    "Random\nBaseline"
]

accuracies = [84.3, 79.1, 75.6, 72.4, 68.9, 50.0]

# Calculate performance drops from full model
drops_from_full = [84.3 - a for a in accuracies]

# Color scheme - different shades of blue for w/o bars, light gray for random baseline
# Reverse the order of w/o bars left to right
colors = ['#2ecc71',  # Full model - green
          '#1abc9c',  # w/o Data Augmentation - teal (swapped)
          '#16a085',  # w/o Pre-training - darker teal (swapped)
          '#2980b9',  # w/o Attention Module - darker blue (reversed)
          '#3498db',  # w/o Augmentation & Pre-training - blue (reversed)
          '#bdc3c7']  # Random baseline - light gray

# Create single figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot: Bar chart with accuracy values and drop annotations
bars = ax.bar(range(len(models)), accuracies, color=colors)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Ablation Study Results', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(models)))
ax.set_xticklabels(models, rotation=0, ha='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylim(45, 85)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.grid(axis='y', visible=False)

# Remove border lines
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Add value labels on bars (accuracy)
for i, (bar, acc) in enumerate(zip(bars, accuracies)):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'{acc:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')

# Add drop annotations next to each bar (except full model)
for i, drop in enumerate(drops_from_full):
    if i == 0:  # Skip full model
        continue
    bar = bars[i]
    x_pos = bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() + 0.05
    y_pos = bar.get_height() + 0.5
    
    # All drop percentages same style
    ax.text(x_pos, y_pos,
            f'↓ {drop:.1f}%',
            ha='left', va='bottom',
            fontsize=16, color='#34495e', fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('ablation_study.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()

print("Figure saved as 'ablation_study.png'")
print("\nKey findings:")
print(f"- Full model accuracy: {accuracies[0]}%")
print(f"- Removing pre-training causes the largest single drop: {drops_from_full[2]:.1f}%")
print(f"- Removing attention module: {drops_from_full[3]:.1f}% drop")
print(f"- Removing data augmentation: {drops_from_full[1]:.1f}% drop")
print(f"- Removing both augmentation and pre-training: {drops_from_full[4]:.1f}% drop")
